bull.narrative: V (T1) maintains its market leadership and continues to expand its financial services offerings, leading to significant revenue growth and a substantial increase in market capitalization.

base.narrative: V (T1) maintains its market position but faces increasing competition, leading to moderate revenue growth and a stable market capitalization.

bear.narrative: V (T1) faces significant disruption to its financial services business, leading to a decline in revenue and a substantial decrease in market capitalization.

tracking_note: Tracking note: Bull scenario assumes V (T1) maintains its market leadership and continues to expand its financial services offerings.
